decisive_items: Serum complement-fixation IgG antibody titers of 1:512
CSF Analysis: Complement-fixation IgG antibody titers: 1:8
response.rationale: High serum and CSF complement-fixation IgG titers, leptomeningeal thickening, and subarachnoid hemorrhage in a patient from an endemic region strongly support neurocysticercosis. Other candidates lack specific serologic confirmation or are contradicted by negative cultures/PCR/angiogram.

rejected.why: Same diagnosis as R3 but less specific label; R3 is the precise entity.
Meningitis is generic; negative bacterial culture and mycobacterial PCR reduce likelihood.
No malaria-specific evidence; hyponatremia is nonspecific and contradicted by negative angiogram.
Negative HIV and no syphilis testing; leptomeningeal thickening is nonspecific.
Negative mycobacterial PCR and no acid-fast evidence; nodular consolidation is nonspecific.
Negative cerebral angiogram contradicts vasculitis; imaging findings are explained by cysticercosis.
